lines.beat: opening the control room
lines.say: The control room, live on Base Sepolia. Three machines, fifty thousand dollars in USDC.
lines.caption:
The control room, live on Base Sepolia.
Three machines, a $50,000 treasury.

lines.beat: CNC-07 is the one degrading
lines.say: C N C oh seven is degrading. Fifty-eight hours before it must be stopped.
lines.caption: CNC-07 is degrading — 58 hours left.

lines.beat: the trend and its projection to Zone D
lines.say: The dashed line is the projection, fitted to the trend.
lines.caption: The projection, fitted to the trend.

lines.beat: who the plant will pay, and nobody else
lines.say: And the only two addresses the plant will pay.
lines.caption:
The only addresses the plant will pay.
The contract rejects any other.

lines.beat: running the agent on the routine lane
lines.say: Now the agent runs.
lines.caption: The agent runs.

lines.beat: running the agent on the routine lane
lines.say: It reads each machine's health, then the shelf — on hand, and what is already on order, because a part on its way covers the machine just as well as one in the store.
lines.caption:
It reads machine health, then the shelf — on hand
and already on order.

lines.beat: running the agent on the routine lane
lines.say: Then the quotes, with each supplier's delivered-on-time record read off the order book rather than kept in a spreadsheet. This is the model deciding, not a replay.
lines.caption:
Then the quotes, with each supplier's record
read off the order book.

lines.beat: running the agent on the routine lane
lines.say: The reasoning is streamed as it happens, rather than arriving in a block after thirty seconds of spinner. A shift assessment is a sequence of decisions, and the sequence is the part worth watching.
lines.caption:
The reasoning streams as it happens.
The sequence is the part worth watching.

lines.beat: capturing the README still
lines.say: Zero in stock, a supplier inside the window, and one hundred and eighty dollars is under the ceiling. It funds it alone.
lines.caption: $180 is under the ceiling — it signs and funds it alone.

lines.beat: advancing the run hour into Zone C
lines.say: Advance the run hour, and the machine crosses into zone C.
lines.caption: Advance the run hour. The machine crosses into Zone C.

lines.beat: now the bearing will not save it — the agent escalates
lines.say: A bearing no longer saves it. By zone C the shaft is already scored, so the agent escalates to the spindle cartridge.
lines.caption:
By Zone C a bearing no longer saves it.
The agent escalates to the spindle.

lines.beat: now the bearing will not save it — the agent escalates
lines.say: Different part, and a very different number. Watch what it does with it.
lines.caption: A different part — and a very different number.

lines.beat: now the bearing will not save it — the agent escalates
lines.say: It also checks the other two machines, and orders nothing for either: one is covered by shelf stock, and the other's trend is too noisy to trust.
lines.caption:
It checks the other two and orders nothing —
one is covered, the other's trend is untrustworthy.

lines.beat: now the bearing will not save it — the agent escalates
lines.say: Every one of those steps is a tool call against the plant's own systems, and every number it quotes came back from one. It is not describing a decision it already made.
lines.caption:
Every step is a tool call against the plant's systems.
It is not narrating a decision already made.

lines.beat: it stops, because $4,000 is over the ceiling
lines.say: Four thousand dollars is over the ceiling, so it stops. The order exists, and no money has moved.
lines.caption:
$4,000 is over the ceiling. It stops.
The order exists. No money moved.

lines.beat: a human approves
lines.say: A human approves it, from a separate key. That approval bypasses the cap — because the cap bounds the agent, not the plant.
lines.caption:
A human approves, from a separate key.
The cap bounds the agent, not the plant.

lines.beat: settling the bearing order
lines.say: Back to the bearing. The supplier despatches, committing to the waybill with their own key.
lines.caption: The supplier commits a waybill with their own key.

lines.beat: settling the bearing order
lines.say: Goods-in confirms against that document, and only then does escrow release to the supplier.
lines.caption:
Goods-in confirms against it.
Only then does escrow release.

lines.beat: issuing the part to the machine
lines.say: The part is issued to the machine. It leaves the store, which is what lets the agent order the next one.
lines.caption:
The part leaves the store — which is what lets
the agent order the next one.

lines.beat: final position
lines.say: Every figure here is a real transaction. One hundred and eighty committed alone, four thousand stopped.
lines.caption:
Every figure is a transaction you can look up.
$180 committed alone. Stopped at $4,000.
